title: First Thing: Nicolás Maduro to appear in New York court on drugs and weapons charges
summary: US officials have warned of further military intervention if Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, fails to meet their demands. Nicolás Maduro, the deposed Venezuelan president, is expected to appear in Manhattan federal court on Monday afternoon on drugs and weapons charges after US special forces seized him in a shocking raid at the weekend. What is the reaction in Caracas? While some quietly rejoiced at Maduro’s demise , the traumatic night-time assault on the city prompted stockpiling, uncertainty and fear. What’s the global impact of Trump’s slashing of climate science? It’s substantial.
